posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina serves major yellow fashion inspiration this summer alongside Alia Bhatt and Kriti Sanon, while fans continue to gush over her protective mom instincts with baby Vihaan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer with Imtiaz Ali drops to massive buzz, while his Born to Shine world tour sets an all-time ticket sales record at Allstate Arena.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF spy thriller Alpha preponed to July 3 — she plays an assassin raised and built to kill in a dark origin story co-starring Sharvari and Bobby Deol.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: A leaked set photo from SS Rajamouli's Ugrabhatti surfaces from the Varanasi caves sequence, as Priyanka visits Mahesh Babu's AMB Cinemas amid shoot buzz.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King becomes a massive reunion — SRK reunites with Anil Kapoor after 31 years, Rani Mukerji after 20 years, and Jackie Shroff after 12 years. Also exits Jailer 2 cameo due to scheduling.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena enters her 'padel era' with a 'Never Say Never' post, while Meghna Gulzar's Daayra co-starring Prithviraj Sukumaran officially wraps filming.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's viral dance video grooving to Michael Jackson's Bad takes over Instagram — caption hints at beau Rahul Mody. Also confirmed alongside Aamir Khan in Ashneer Grover biopic.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika steps out for the first time after announcing her second pregnancy, with Ranveer protectively by her side — fans celebrate 'Lil Dhurandhar' arriving soon.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Don 3 controversy with Farhan Akhtar escalates as FWICE takes a strict stand — Ranveer's ₹35 crore private settlement offer was reportedly rejected. Security beefed up after extortion threat.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stuns at Cannes 2026 with a dramatic swan-inspired couture finale and cosmic sculptural look by Amit Aggarwal — daughter Aaradhya joins her on the red carpet in blush pink.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is everywhere — Cocktail 2 promotions with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon are in full swing with trailer dropping June 2; she playfully clears the viral shoulder moment with Shahid.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Newlywed Samantha is glowing after marrying filmmaker Raj Nidimoru (of Raj & DK fame), while her next film Maa Inti Bangaaram teaser hints at a powerful new avatar.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Post Pushpa 2, all eyes are on Allu Arjun's Raaka with Atlee — a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle unlike anything he's done before. Peddi glimpse still holds the all-time views record at 175M+.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi fever is real — Ram Charan's sports drama hits theatres June 4 with AR Rahman's music. The Bhopal musical event drew massive crowds with a live Rahman performance.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon glimpse smashes 105M views (64M on day 1, 3rd highest ever in Indian cinema). War 2 with Hrithik drops Aug 14 — Telugu states getting ₹100 crore distribution offers.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi gears up for Peddi release on June 4 alongside Ram Charan — fires back at critics calling Hellallallo song 'vulgar' and talks about growing up as a star kid.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya celebrates her 27th birthday with Suhana Khan, Shanaya, and Bollywood well-wishers. Her all-white ethnic look from a recent event continues to go viral.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara is juggling blockbusters — female lead in War 2 alongside Hrithik and Jr NTR (Aug 14 release), and Don 3 with Ranveer. Steals spotlight at Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 shoot wraps after 18 months — Hrithik and Jr NTR's spy thriller hits cinemas Aug 14 in IMAX. Also approached for Jailer 2 cameo after Shah Rukh Khan's exit.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun is on a promo blitz for Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with Mrunal and Pooja Hegde, but Vashu Bhagnani's ₹400 crore lawsuit over song rights threatens the release.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announces her massive Unstoppable Tour 2026 across 17+ cities in the US and Canada — Boston, Newark, Toronto, LA, and more starting September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman reunites with Shekhar Kapur for Masoom: The New Generation as both composer and co-producer. Also delivered a live performance at Ram Charan's Peddi musical event in Bhopal.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Chief Minister Vijay's blockbuster political debut — TVK wins 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections. His final film Jana Nayagan is now eyeing a June 19 release amid renewed fan frenzy.
